meta.scope: Iran Batch 4 — Industry, provincial structure (Tehran, Khuzestan/oil provinces), and banking system densification.

candidates.title: Industrial production and manufacturing statistics
candidates.description: Official statistics on industrial establishments, manufacturing output, value added and related indicators. Industry operates under sanctions constraints on technology, finance and intermediate imports.

candidates.title: Tehran province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Tehran province — by far the largest provincial economy, typically accounting for roughly one-fifth or more of national GDP. Dominant services, administration and industrial concentration.
candidates.notes: Primary capital-region economic node. Strongest single provincial share.

candidates.title: Khuzestan province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Khuzestan — the principal oil-producing province and consistently one of the largest provincial economies after Tehran. Hydrocarbon activity dominates the local output structure.
referenced_by: National Accounts and oil production statistics

candidates.title: Oil-producing provinces spatial framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from SCI provincial and petroleum sources
candidates.description: System-level view of the main oil- and gas-producing provinces whose output underpins national hydrocarbon revenues and whose local economies are tightly linked to the energy sector.
referenced_by: Khuzestan GRDP and oil production nodes
candidates.notes: Spatial densification of the hydrocarbon cluster.

candidates.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. Operates under sanctions constraints on international correspondent relationships and domestic asset-quality pressures.

candidates.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of Iran / bank disclosures
candidates.description: System-wide and bank-level non-performing loan and asset-quality indicators. Asset quality is a recurring concern under high inflation, sanctions and directed-credit pressures.
candidates.notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.

candidates.title: Iran industry–provincial–banking densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from SCI and CBI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding industrial production statistics, Tehran GRDP, Khuzestan GRDP, oil-producing provinces framing, banking-system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent industry–spatial–financial layer.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
Oil, fiscal, sanctions and macro series from earlier batches
